mapper.select: select s.id, s.category_id, s.name, s.price, s.description, s.image, s.update_time, c.name as category_name, s.status, s.create_employee_name, s.update_employee_name, sd.id as setmeal_dish_id, sd.setmeal_id, sd.dish_id, sd.name as dish_name, sd.price as dish_price, sd.copies, sdf.id as sdf_id, sdf.setmeal_dish_id as sdf_setmeal_dish_id, sdf.flavor_id as sdf_flavor_id, sdf.flavor_value as sdf_flavor_value, sdf.flavor_name as sdf_flavor_name, sdf.value_list as sdf_value_list from setmeal s inner join setmeal_dish sd on sd.setmeal_id = s.id inner join category c on c.id = s.category_id left join setmeal_dish_flavor sdf on sd.id = sdf.setmeal_dish_id where s.id = #{id} order by sd.id
